notes.title: 1.03 Patch notes
notes.content:
We greatly appreciate all your feedback and have made adjustments to the game balance for an improved experience.

Adjustments and updates:

- Added more autosave checkpoints in certain areas to reduce the penalty for dying.
- Decreased the rate at which stamina is consumed while running.
- Reduced the number of enemies or replaced them in specific areas.
- Corrected map images in certain areas.
- Fixed some images and texts.
- Addressed incorrect GUI button hints.

notes.title: 1.02 Patch notes
